Scope of Work and Boundary

Scope of Work and Boundary
While the agreed scope of work comprised a limited level of assurance on the GRI disclosures in the Report, including a review of the double materiality assessment, a reasonable level of assurance was performed for selected indicators under the BRSR Core framework, as detailed below:
GRI 302: Energy 2016 – 302-1, 302-3
GRI 303: Water and Effluents 2018 – 303-3, 303-4, 303-5

GRI 418: Customer Privacy 2016 – 418-1
The reported topic boundaries of non-financial performance are based on the internal and external materiality assessment covering the Company’s operations as brought out in the section ‘About this Report’ of the report.
Based on the agreed scope with the Company, the boundary of limited level of assurance covers the operations of Cipla across all global locations.

DNV has complied with the Code of Conduct during the assurance engagement. Conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode and there
will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need
assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star then zero on
your touchtone phone. Please note that this conference is being recorded. We have with us in
today's conference, Mr. Achin Gupta, MD and Global CEO; Mr. Dinesh Jain, Global CFO; and

I now hand the conference over to Ms. Diksha Maheshwari. Thank you, and over to you, ma'am.
Diksha Maheshwari: Thank you, Shaurya. Good afternoon, and a very warm welcome to Cipla's Q2 FY27 Earnings
Call. I'm Diksha Maheshwari from the Investor Relations team at Cipla. Let me draw your
attention to the fact that on this call, our discussion will include certain forward-looking
statements, which are predictions, projections or other estimates about future events.
These estimates reflect management's current expectations of the future performance of the
company. Please note that these estimates involve several risks and uncertainties that could cause
our actual results to differ materially from what is expressed or implied. Cipla does not undertake
any obligation to publicly update any forward-looking statements, whether as a result of new
confirmations, future events or otherwise. I hope you have received the investor presentation
that we have posted on our website. I would like to request Achin to take over.
Achin Gupta: Thank you, Diksha. Good afternoon to all of you, and we appreciate you joining our Q2 FY '27
earnings call. We are pleased to report a revenue of INR7,404 crores with a steady sequential
growth of 4% Q-o-Q. This was supported by a broad-based performance across our key
businesses.

chunks.section: Oct 2026 earnings call · Q2 FY2027 · Prepared by: Simona Dsouza
chunks.text:
businesses.
One India recorded its highest ever quarterly revenue, while our global portfolio continued to
demonstrate resilience amidst a dynamic operating environment. We continue to invest in
pipeline, and we received key approvals, including our first DPI approval of generic Advair in
the U.S.
In line with our objective of strengthening Biosimilar pipeline, we partnered with Qilu for
Pembrolizumab in North America, and we initiated clinical development for one more
respiratory Biosimilar asset out of our own pipeline. Together, these developments reinforce our
confidence in the long-term opportunities across our markets and portfolio.
Coming to business-wise performance. One India delivered 12% Y-o-Y growth, sustaining its
track record of consistent double-digit growth over the last few quarters, driven by strong
execution across key therapies and the resilience of our franchise in the IPM. In our branded
prescription business, we continue to outperform the market, delivering 15% growth, which was
led by the chronic portfolio as per IQVIA YTD September '26.
Our key chronic therapies continue to grow ahead of their respective markets with respiratory
growing 11%; antidiabetes grew 50%, including the GLP; urology, 11%; and dermatology 16%.
This was underpinned by strong brand equity, robust volume growth, effective field execution

Cipla Limited October 27, 2026

chunks.section: Oct 2026 earnings call · Q2 FY2027 · Prepared by: Simona Dsouza
chunks.text:
Cipla Limited October 27, 2026
and sustained momentum from new product introductions. Our overall chronic mix stood at
60.3% as per IQVIA MAT September '26.
Our launch momentum remains strong. During the quarter, we strengthened our portfolio
through targeted launches across key therapies, including Revesmart in respiratory, Galvus DM
and SR in antidiabetes, Dytor E in cardiovascular and Rizontem in anti-infectives. These
launches collectively underscore our focus on deepening our presence in priority therapy areas
and further add to the breadth and competitiveness of our portfolio as we continue to lead IPM
in terms of volume share.
We also entered into an exclusive licensing agreement with CTTQ, SinoBiopharma Group,
company for an asset -- novel asset, HER2 bispecific antibody drug conjugate. This partnership
further strengthens our innovative oncology portfolio and expands our presence in the next-
generation targeted cancer therapies.
On our trade generic business, delivered a strong double-digit Q-o-Q growth. Expanding the
portfolio remains a key growth driver here with 15-plus new launches this quarter. On our
Consumer Health business, we continued the upward trajectory with Nicotex, Omnigel and
Cipladine consolidating their leadership positions in their segments.
The business is driving healthy secondary growth and actively exploring opportunities to invest

chunks.section: Oct 2026 earnings call · Q2 FY2027 · Prepared by: Simona Dsouza
chunks.text:
The business is driving healthy secondary growth and actively exploring opportunities to invest
in products and channels to further expand the distribution. Operating profitability improved,
reflecting the strength and scalability of our consumer health strategy. Coming to North
America, we delivered a quarterly revenue of $172 million in Q2, which represents a $10 million
improvement versus previous quarter.
We remain confident of furthering this momentum through the remainder of this year, supported
by our launch pipeline and scale up of these new assets. Cipla continues to hold the number one
position in overall U.S. Albuterol MDI market this quarter as well with our market share of 22%
as per IQVIA data for last week of September '26.
So far this year, we have secured approvals for 2 key respiratory products with generic Ventolin
approved in Q1 and generic Advair approved in Q2. Notably, generic Advair approval marked
our first DPI approval from U.S.-based manufacturing network, further validating our
differentiated respiratory capabilities and reinforcing our commitment to complex rescue
therapies.
Another important strategic milestone during the quarter was our exclusive partnership with Qilu
Pharmaceutical for the U.S. commercialization of a biosimilar to Keytruda, Pembrolizumab.
Looking ahead, we remain focused on enhancing the performance of our North America

chunks.section: Oct 2026 earnings call · Q2 FY2027 · Prepared by: Simona Dsouza
chunks.text:
Looking ahead, we remain focused on enhancing the performance of our North America
business through a combination of new product launches and disciplined commercial execution.
A quick update on our pipeline. Our pipeline for this financial year includes 3 additional
significant launches for the U.S., which is in line with our previous guidance. This includes two
more respiratory assets and 1 key peptide opportunity. Additionally, we have four biosimilar
programs under development for global markets, which continue to advance steadily through
key development milestones.
Page 3 of 15
Cipla Limited October 27, 2026
Alongside these efforts, we remain focused on strengthening our R&D capabilities, particularly
for the U.S. market. We are progressing well on the organic pipeline development with
approximately 45 to 50 filings planned over the next 3 years. In South Africa private market, we
achieved a strong secondary growth of 6.5%, which outperformed the market of 5% as per
IQVIA MAT August '26.
One Africa business continued to strengthen its position through solid performance in key
therapies and successful new launches, reinforcing our presence across diverse markets. In
EMEU, we delivered revenues of $101 million during the quarter. While the business operated
in a challenging geopolitical environment.

chunks.section: Oct 2026 earnings call · Q2 FY2027 · Prepared by: Simona Dsouza
chunks.text:
in a challenging geopolitical environment.
And there were certain market-specific headwinds, we demonstrated resilience through strong
execution and cost discipline across both GTM as well as B2B segment. A word on the
regulatory front. We continue to make steady progress across our global manufacturing network.
During the last quarter, U.S. FDA classified the inspection at our Invagen Unit 3 facility in New
York as a Voluntary Action Indicated, VAI. And during the current month, the U.S. FDA
conducted a routine GMP inspection at our Invagen manufacturing facility in Long Island, New
York, which concluded with 0 Form 483 observations.
As you're aware, U.S. FDA also conducted a follow-up GMP inspection at our Pithampur facility
in India in this previous quarter and issued 7 observations in Form 483. We continue to engage
constructively with the U.S. FDA and remain committed to maintaining the highest standards of
quality and compliance across our network.
Overall, we continue to focus on sustained growth in our core businesses, improving
productivity and strengthening our pipeline in order to serve the patients with trusted high-
quality medicine. Now I would like to invite Dinesh to present the financial and operational

reported a quarterly revenue of INR7,404 crores with a sequential growth of 4% quarter-on-
quarter. The EBITDA margin, excluding the other income, stood at 18.7% for the quarter,
reflecting a sequential improvement of 200 basis points.

confident of continuing this trajectory over the remainder of the year. The reported gross margin
after material costs stood at 64.4%, up 7% quarter-on-quarter, supported largely by an improved
product mix.

quarter. This increase reflects our planned investment in the upcoming product launches and
enhanced manufacturing readiness. We remain focused on innovation and future readiness.

the product filing and key development programs. We continue to guide for the full year R&D

expense in the range of 6% to 7% of the revenue. Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR878

our balance sheet, including lease liabilities, stood at INR699 crores with a net cash equivalent

sustainable long-term growth. In our branded prescription business, we delivered a double-digit
